scripts.build: tsc && cp package.json dist/ && (cp package-lock.json dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && cp global-bundle.pem dist/
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && npm install --omit=dev && zip -r ../lambda-pdf-analyzer.zip .
scripts.deploy: npm run package && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name home-fit-pdf-analyzer --zip-file fileb://lambda-pdf-analyzer.zip --profile aidlc --region us-east-1
